purpose: specs/chances/rigor-in-context.md "Pilot": check the CRDC 2023–24 AP course count (rigor.ap_courses, SCH_APCOURSES) against a second source before the rigor reading is shown to everyone.
ledger_year_note: The newest year the Ledger published on the measurement date; the 2025–26 ledger stays current until the 2026–27 one is released. The same lookups also give the 2023–24 list (the CRDC year), reported as same_year_2023_24.

ledger_lookup.search: POST https://apcourseaudit.inflexion.org/api/ledger/search {"institution":"S","country":"US","state":"TX","city":"Azle"} (or "name") → results[{ai, fullname, city, zip}]; needs the page's csrf-token meta and session cookie (X-CSRF-TOKEN, X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest)
ledger_lookup.bulk_download: Only for a school's own AP coordinator (institution id + access code); no public download.

counting: Distinct AP subjects with an authorization in the Ledger year (authorized_count counts teachers; a subject counts once). AP Seminar and AP Research (Capstone) count; Pre-AP (listed separately by the Ledger) does not. CRDC SCH_APCOURSES is "the number of different AP courses".
matching: Searched by state and city, then by a distinctive name word statewide when needed; the school was matched by name and address by hand. No match or more than one plausible match is recorded as unmatched/ambiguous, not guessed.
course_keys: ledger_courses[].key maps the Ledger subject to data/reference/ap-courses.json; null for retired subjects (Computer Science AB, French Literature, Latin Literature, Physics B), none of which appear in the current year.
